reporter_cluster_pie_handbook_ai_notes.description: 2-slice pie: Up / Down day distribution from binary ternary
4-slice pie: Big Up / Small Up / Small Down / Big Down from nested ternary
4-slice donut (inner=50%): Q1–Q4 volume share by quarter
3-slice pie with semantic colors: Gap Up (green) / Flat (gray) / Gap Down (red)
3-slice thin donut (inner=70%): RSI regime Oversold / Neutral / Overbought
5-slice pie: Mon–Fri volume by day of week from nested ternary
2-slice pie with compound boolean: Uptrend / Consolidation via SMA50×SMA200 flags
3-slice donut (inner=40%, order=5): Low Vol / Medium Vol / High Vol range classification
4-slice pie sorted largest-first via sort_by_value=Descending
3-slice cross-sectional pie: price-weighted allocation using Last close
3-slice donut (inner=60%): total return contribution per asset via Sum agg
3-slice pie with custom colors: volatility contribution via Std agg
3-slice pie: average volume share per asset via Mean agg
3-slice donut (inner=55%) with colors: worst return per asset via Min agg
3-slice pie: top 2 assets by volume + Other bucket from max_assets=2
3-slice pie sorted smallest-first via sort_by_value=Ascending + Mean agg
